name: Reminders List
description: Shared to-do lists that everyone edits in the iPhone Reminders app. The lists live in Radicale on the Pi; the module shows one or all of them, large enough to read across the room.
author: Ryan

listUrl.title: Address
listUrl.description: The family account's address shows every list under Home, including ones made on a phone later: http://192.168.1.14:5232/family/ (the Pi's network address, not localhost). Or one or more list addresses, separated by commas, for just those.

username.title: User name
username.description: The read-only account the installer made for the dashboard.

password.title: Password
password.description: The display account's password, printed by the installer. It can only read lists, never change them.

onlyLists.title: Only these lists
onlyLists.description: With the account address: list names, separated by commas, in the order to show them, e.g. "Household, Groceries". Empty shows every list, in the phones' order.

title.title: Heading
title.description: One list: leave empty to use its name from the phones. Several lists: shown above them, or nothing when empty.

showHeader.title: Show heading
showHeader.description: The heading above the lists: a single list's name, or the Heading text above several lists. Each of several lists always has its own heading.

listColors.title: Each list's color from the phones
listColors.description: For its heading, rings and priority marks. Off uses the Accent color for all.

hideEmpty.title: Hide empty lists
hideEmpty.description: With several lists, leave out the ones with nothing to do.

sortBy.title: Order
sortBy.description: Phone order follows the order items are dragged into in Reminders; items it has no order for go by when they were added.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Auto adds a second or third column only when the list doesn't fit in one, and the module is wide enough.

keepDoneHours.title: Keep checked-off items for (hours)
keepDoneHours.description: Shown crossed out at the bottom, so everyone sees what got done. 0 hides them at once.

emptyText.title: When the list is empty, show

textScale.title: Text size
textScale.description: On top of the Style panel's Text size. Larger fits fewer items.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Checkboxes, the heading underline, priority marks and things due today.
